verdict.rationale: Customer.io's docs list a primary OpenAPI spec covering the Track, App, and Design Studio APIs at the conventional path. A live probe confirmed https://docs.customer.io/openapi.json returns HTTP 200 with an "openapi" key. A Postman collection and the self-describing `cio schema` command add further machine-readable descriptions. Missing for 10: no evidence the spec covers the Pipelines API, and no in-depth first-party documentation of the spec's scope or versioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Primary OpenAPI spec for the Track (ingress), App, and Design Studio APIs together, at the conventional path
We've generated a Postman collection to help you get started with our APIs.
